description: The answers, once the privacy threshold is met (open link: 5 answers; targeted: minPercent of the list). Below it the count and what is still needed. Each transcript is anonymous by construction — no field links an answer to a person. Includes the AI report if analyze_campaign has run. Answers are deleted 30 days after the campaign closes (dataDeletesAt).
